subject: Finera onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service-account audit - kickoff
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dubois <alex.dubois@finera.com>, Priya Rao <priya.ra@finera.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Finera onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service-account audit - kickoff

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks for choosing Redwood. This thread is our kickoff to align CS, engineering, and security on the access-control work required for your enterprise rollout. High-level scope for the first two weeks:

- SSO/SAML integration (IdP metadata exchange, ACS URLs, attribute mapping)
- SCIM provisioning for user sync and group mapping
- IP allowlist for admin console and webhook endpoints (staging + prod)
- Service-account inventory and least-privilege mapping (for integrations and automation)
- Org policies: session timeouts and role boundaries for admins and operators

Attached: redwood_onboard_checklist.pdf (summary), and a template service_account_inventory.csv that we ask you to fill out.

Proposed near-term milestones:
1) By EOD next Tuesday (2027-05-31): Finera shares SAML metadata and current IdP contact + completed inventory template for service accounts.
2) By 2027-06-03: Redwood provides SCIM attribute mapping proposal and a draft IP allowlist for staging.
3) Week of 2027-06-07: Dry-run of SSO in staging and verification of SCIM provisioning for a pilot group.

Action items from Redwood (owners in parens):
- Prepare SCIM mappings and sample payloads (Ben)
- Validate SAML ACS / signing algorithm compatibility and provide IdP guide (Jonas)
- Coordinate DocuSign for PSA/terms if needed (Monica)

Alex, can you confirm who from your Identity/Network teams will be the point of contact and share the IdP metadata? If possible include a small list of IP ranges we should expect for outbound connections and admin console access.

If these timelines look tight for your team, call that out and we will adjust.

Best,
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_onboard_checklist.pdf, service_account_inventory.csv
From: Alex Dubois <alex.dubois@finera.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.ra@finera.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finera onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service-account audit - kickoff

Thanks Sean — appreciate the clear plan.

I am Alex (Finera IT / Identity lead). Priya (cc) will take lead on the SCIM side and will coordinate with our network team about IP ranges. We can provide SAML metadata; attaching a copy of our current metadata and the service account inventory filled with the first-pass we have. Note: a few of the service accounts are currently owned by a third-party vendor (LogiSafe) and will require a short approval window.

Attachments: finera_saml_metadata.xml, service_account_inventory_filled.csv

Questions from our side:
- For SCIM, what attributes do you require to map groups to RBAC roles?
- For IP allowlist, can you confirm whether Redwood supports CIDR blocks up to /16 for enterprise admin access?

We can do a technical call Tuesday 2027-05-31 at 10:00 AM PT if that works for the team.

Alex Dubois
Identity & Platform Lead, Finera Systems
alex.dubois@finera.com
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dubois <alex.dubois@finera.com>, Priya Rao <priya.ra@finera.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Finera onboarding: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service-account audit - kickoff

Alex — perfect, thanks for the quick turnaround and attachments. Confirming the Tuesday 10:00 AM PT technical call. Monica will send a calendar invite with a dial-in and shared drive link.

Quick answers:
- SCIM attributes: We typically require userName, displayName, emails, and an externalGroupId attribute to map groups. For role mapping we ask for a group-to-role CSV during the pilot (Ben will provide the template).
- IP allowlist: Yes, we support CIDR blocks up to /16 for enterprise admin console access. For webhook endpoints we recommend narrower CIDR ranges where possible.

Mutual action plan update (short):
- Finera sends filled inventory and confirms third-party owned accounts (Alex) — by EOD Tue 2027-05-31
- Redwood provides SCIM mapping template and initial role map example (Ben/Jonas) — by Fri 2027-06-03
- Tech call Tue 2027-05-31 10:00 AM PT to walk SAML metadata and staging IPs (all)
- Post-call: Redwood will provision a staging tenant and share test accounts for your pilot users (Monica)

DocuSign for the addendum will be sent if we need the enterprise PSA amendment; Monica will confirm after the call.

See you on Tuesday.

Best,
Sean

All — follow-up after reviewing Alex's filled inventory. I pulled the service account list and marked ownership and current privileges. Summary highlights:

- Total service accounts listed: 18
- Third-party vendor owned: 3 (LogiSafe integration, will need vendor signoff)
- Privileges: 6 accounts have wide admin scopes; recommend scoping down to role-limited tokens for automation where possible

Proposed immediate actions (technical):
1) Rotate any long-lived keys for accounts used by CI/CD and replace with short-lived tokens tied to service accounts where supported. (Owner: Ben)
2) Create RBAC role mapping file from Finera groups to Redwood roles; sample attached as role_map_example.csv in the shared drive. (Owner: Ben/Jonas)
3) Apply staging IP allowlist: 34.120.0.0/16 and 34.121.128.0/18 for initial testing. Confirm with Finera network if those ranges are acceptable. (Owner: Jonas)

I'll be on the Tue 10:00 AM PT call and can walk through the inventory line-by-line.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Staff Engineer, Onboarding & Integrations
Redwood Inference
